LESSON: CAPACITY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Measurement
Topic 2.3: Capacity
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Capacity, part of Measurement in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade one MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we find out which of two containers hold more, less or same as?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Capacity together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: learner determines capacity of containers by filling bigger containers with water basins from smaller

containers.

● Problem solving: learner reuses containers of different capacities at home and at school.

Values:
● Responsibility: learner re-uses containers to keep items at home and school.

● Unity: learner jointly with others fills bigger containers with water using different small containers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Safety issues: learner collects safe containers of different sizes from the environment.

● Sustainable consumption: learner reuses of containers at home and school.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the skill of reusing empty containers to the skills of waste management in Environmental

Activities.
